description: Reads a Zarr array store and returns its values as a table.
comment: Supports local paths and object-store URLs. Use table_name or dims to select one table from a multi-table group, or group_path to read a nested group.

description: Lists every group's tables in a Zarr store, with the schema and table name each maps to.
comment: Use this to discover valid table_name/dims values before scanning multi-table datasets. read_zarr_groups is the 0.1.x name for this function.
example: SELECT table_name, dims, data_vars FROM read_zarr_tables('path/to/store.zarr');

description: Lists the dimension groups available in a Zarr store (0.1.x name for read_zarr_tables).
comment: Use this to discover valid dims values before scanning multi-group datasets.

description: Returns array metadata for a Zarr store, including names, dimensions, shapes, and data types.
comment: Use this to inspect a dataset and choose the array_path for nested stores such as OME-Zarr images.
example: SELECT name, dims, shape, dtype FROM read_zarr_metadata('image.ome.zarr');

description: Returns the SQL statements that mount every table of a Zarr store as a view in a given database.
comment: Run the returned statements to materialize the views; view_names renames them.
